A.explanation: With $n=1$ the denominator has units of $\text{kg s}^{-1}$, not the $\text{kg m s}^{-2}$ of force, so $C_d$ would not be dimensionless.

B.explanation: With $n=2$ the units of $v^2 \rho A$ are $\text{kg m s}^{-2}$, matching $F$, so $C_d$ has no units.

C.explanation: With $n=3$ the denominator has units of $\text{kg m}^2 \text{s}^{-3}$, which does not match force, so $C_d$ would have units of $\text{m}^{-1} \text{s}$.

D.explanation: With $n=4$ the denominator has units of $\text{kg m}^3 \text{s}^{-4}$, which does not match force, so $C_d$ would not be dimensionless.

hints: Notice that $C_d$ has no units, so the denominator $v^n \rho A$ must have exactly the same base units as the drag force $F$.
Write each quantity in base SI units: $F$ in $\text{kg m s}^{-2}$, $\rho$ in $\text{kg m}^{-3}$, $A$ in $\text{m}^2$ and $v$ in $\text{m s}^{-1}$.
Combine the powers of $\text{m}$ and $\text{s}$ in $v^n \rho A$ and require them to equal $\text{m}^1 \text{s}^{-2}$ to solve for $n$.
walkthrough: Since $C_d$ is dimensionless and $2$ has no units, the denominator must have the same units as the numerator: units of $v^n \rho A$ = units of $F$.
In SI base units, $[F] = \text{kg m s}^{-2}$, $[\rho] = \text{kg m}^{-3}$, $[A] = \text{m}^2$ and $[v] = \text{m s}^{-1}$.
Equate powers with $[F] = \text{kg m}^1 \text{s}^{-2}$: for $\text{s}$, $-n = -2$, and for $\text{m}$, $n-1 = 1$.
Both conditions give $n = 2$, which makes the $\text{kg}$, $\text{m}$ and $\text{s}$ powers balance so $C_d$ has no units. This is option B.
